اعتبروا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَبَرُوا (iʕtabarū) /iʕ.ta.ba.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# اُعْتُبِرُوا (uʕtubirū) /uʕ.tu.bi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# اِعْتَبِرُوا (iʕtabirū) /iʕ.ta.bi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
